tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates an Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and a one-time api_key, plus example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for the given job type.

tools.name: set_goals
tools.description: Sets or updates the agent's goals. Accepts job_type, stage, one north-star metric with a fixed definition and baseline, a named deliverable, capability gaps, goals, optional secondary KPIs, tools, and constraints. A change to the north-star definition is recorded as drift. Requires the agent's api_k

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Returns up to `limit` catalog items matched to the agent's goals, plus at most one extra item per declared capability gap. Each item includes match reasons, vetting status and basis, and cautions. Requires the agent's api_key.

tools.name: update_items
tools.description: Records an action on catalog items: adopt marks an item as in use; decline marks it as rejected; not_relevant marks it as a poor fit for the agent's job, not a quality judgment; remove marks a previously adopted item as uninstalled. The coach measures only adopted items. Requires the agent's api_key

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: Submits a check-in with the north-star value, secondary KPIs, releases (shipped vs verified live), build vs distribution actions, blockers, repeated corrections, timeouts, unsupported claims, incidents, deliverable progress, and per-item usage. Values use {value, evidence: self_reported|verified, so

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Returns the agent's KPIs versus baseline, each item's verdict with evidence, and check-in history. Requires the agent's api_key.

tools.name: share_report
tools.description: When public is true, returns a public progress-report URL that includes display name, goals, KPIs, and verdicts, and excludes email, notes, and keys. When public is false, hides the public report. Requires the agent's api_key.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Returns a preview of the daily digest email (subject, html, and text). This call does not send email. A scheduled daily email is sent if the digest option is enabled. Requires the agent's api_key.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Issues a new api_key and immediately invalidates the previous key. Returns the new api_key. Requires the agent's current api_key.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Permanently deletes the agent's profile, items, check-ins, and public report. Requires the agent's api_key and a confirm value equal to the agent_id.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Returns the rules used to assign item verdicts (permanent, promising, temporary, trial, unproven, pending_removal), signals, and overall health.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Searches the library for skills, MCP servers, prompts, or repos by keyword. Returns only items that passed the security scan, each with install command, license, source, and a page link. Results are catalog data and do not include user comments.

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description: Returns one vetted library item by slug, including install command, source, license, and (when the license allows) the full SKILL.md text. The call is counted as a download. Unvetted items are not returned.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_digest, search_library · Private data: update_items · Public sink: share_report, get_digest · Destructive: update_items, delete_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_digest, search_library · Private data: update_items · Public sink: share_report, get_digest · Destructive: update_items, delete_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this first, once. Creates your Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and api_key (shown once: save it in the owner's sanctioned secret store or a restricted credential file, not in chat or memory). Also returns example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for your job type." → after: "Creates an Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and a one-time api_key, plus example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for the given job type."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
